page.layout: One page of text, centred. A decorative ornament at the top and another at the foot, both without text. The dedication address runs in the centre of the page, with no margin notes and no running head.

main_text.head: VIRO CLARISSIMO DOCTISSIMOQ. D. IOAN. NICOL. STVPANO, MEDICINÆ VTRIVSQ. Doctori & Professori in Academia Basiliensi celeberrimo, PHILOSOPHO EXIMIO, Medico eleganti, SVO ANTEHAC IN ORGANO ARISTOTELEO, nunc verò in Medicinæ studio Theorico, Præceptori & Doctori fidelissimo, Patrono quoq; maximo:
main_text.p: HASCE SVAS LOGICAS THESES, Operæ fideliter præstitæ Testimonium, Inscribit & P. A. Offert.

page.notes: The addressee block is set in capitals with a large decorative initial D and an italic "Medico eleganti". The "S" of "SVO" is decorative. "STV-PANO" and "ARISTO-teleo" are hyphenated at the line ends and are written whole, with the hyphen kept only where printed. "Basilien si" appears with a space in the print and is read as Basiliensi. The name line "IOAN. GEORGIVS LEO" and the closing line are set in italic. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
